metadata.title: River research order, 2026-10-10
metadata.purpose: One-time research-order data only; no new river-name findings, product change or automatic name application.
metadata.queue_rank: Sequential rank of unrecorded targets only. All eligible river IDs occur once, including recorded assessments retained for status visibility. Recorded rows have null rank and must not be repeated as new research.
metadata.phase_completion: Complete a review pass across the continent and maintain an explicit unresolved list before moving on. Prior candidates and scope holds are recorded assessments, not fully resolved identities. Address available unresolved work in the current continent; never silently bypass it to jump continents. Document any genuine access/material blocker. Lakes remain deferred until every river continent has had its pass.
metadata.source_notes: HydroRIVERS Technical Documentation v1.0, sections 3.1-3.2 (pages 4-5), describes regional tiles, the first digit of HYRIV_ID, and MAIN_RIV. Original inventory IDs are treated as MAIN_RIV region hints, with bbox overrides below. The r47/r48 deltas add lakes only, leaving 43 recorded rivers. No unavailable historical 504-target verdicts are assumed restored.

assignment_convention.region_1: Africa, including Madagascar; Suez-area bounds flagged.
assignment_convention.region_9: Americas (Greenland, geographically grouped with North America).
assignment_convention.region_2_Eurasia_midpoint_convention: Use bbox midpoint, not political country. Longitude <26E: Europe. For latitude >=47N, compare longitude with the piecewise-linear west/east divider through (latitude,longitude) pairs (47,51),(49,51),(52,55),(55,59),(60,60),(70,66),(90,66); west is Europe, east is Asia. Below 47N: longitude >=50E is Asia; from 38E to 50E, latitude >=45-(longitude-38)*5/12 is Europe, otherwise Asia; farther west, latitude >=42N or latitude >=40.5N with longitude <29E is Europe, otherwise Asia. These rough divisions assign the Middle East to Asia and flag boundary zones.
assignment_convention.region_5_SE_Asia_Oceania_midpoint_conven: Use bbox midpoint: longitude <130E and latitude >=11S -> Asia; otherwise Other (Australia/Oceania). This places much of Indonesia and the Philippines in Asia and New Guinea in Other. Flag island-boundary belt 120E-135E, 12S-5N.

metadata.boundary_limitations: Continent is a pragmatic research-order label, not an authoritative geographic finding. Bbox midpoint is not an outlet or length-weighted centroid; rectangles can cross a divider when the river does not, and this method cannot prove every real cross-continent reach. Flagged targets retain one provisional continent and are never duplicated. Region-2 flag corridors are Aegean/Thrace 25-30E,38-43N; Caucasus 38-51E,40-47N; Urals/Caspian 48-69E,45-73N. Opposite bbox-corner assignments also trigger a boundary flag. Flags require attention in that assigned continent, not exclusion from the queue.
metadata.existing_status: 34 recorded supported representative identities, 2 recorded candidates and 7 recorded river-group name-scope holds. Prior record links retain the actual evidence and scope wording; this queue does not replace or upgrade them.
metadata.r49: Stopped partial lake work is not counted as recorded, complete, or as a river result; preserve its notes separately in the same publication bundle.
metadata.lakes: 610 eligible original lake IDs; 98 have records through r48, leaving 512 unrecorded. No lake ordering or research is started here; all lake phases follow all river phases.
metadata.publication_boundary: Only original IDs, bounded inventory metadata, assignment/order/status facts and public source URLs. No full geometry, private source fingerprints or machine-local paths.
